description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy or correlation values for three different metrics—Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy—across five models. The horizontal axis represents the model names: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For each model, there are three bars representing the three metrics; the bars are colored light coral for Sentiment Accuracy, light green for STS Correlation, and light steelblue for Paraphrase Accuracy. For the Single-task_baseline model, the Sentiment Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.52, the STS Correlation bar reaches approximately 0.62, and the Paraphrase Accuracy bar reaches approximately 0.64. The 2-Tier SimCSE model has the highest values, with Sentiment Accuracy at approximately 0.78, STS Correlation at approximately 0.80, and Paraphrase Accuracy at approximately 0.79. The bars are grouped by model, with each metric represented side-by-side for comparison within each model. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
